verdict.rationale: Deel Immigration is a SaaS platform, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a sandbox, test mode, or developer environment, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every path. The evidence covers only production-facing visa services: eligibility checks, case managers, application tracking and renewals.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
